narrative.overview: This is a scoped record of the existing application world, not a replacement brand direction. Product administration uses compact, clearly labelled controls, restrained neutral surfaces and teal actions. Buyer pages prioritize the selected price, duration and purchase action. Chinese copy uses the application's system font stack.
keyCharacteristics: Existing teal actions and paired light/dark neutral surfaces.
One SKU editor for single and multiple specifications.
Explicit manual and automatic delivery choices.
Responsive field rows with a persistent dialog action area.
dos: Do reuse the shared CatalogTabs, BaseDialog, DataTable, buttons and inputs.
Do preserve visible units, labelled selection states and readable dark secondary text.
Do keep mobile fields above the nonshrinking dialog footer.
donts: Don't infer delivery mode or SKU pricing from the selected usage guide.
Don't turn the shop layout into a new global design contract.
Don't treat screenshot sample prices as product defaults.
